text:
Ashley: FYI int8 bringup for zephyr-v2 flagged weird outputs on a macaronic test set (mixed CJK + Arabic + Latin). Example below.

Jorge: what weird? can you paste an example?

Ashley: sure — input and outputs:

```
Input: 今天天气很好، but the forecast says 明日可能雨. Also: hello مرحبا ありがとう
Expected translation (EN): 'Today's weather is nice, but the forecast says tomorrow may rain. Also: hello, hello, thank you'
zephyr-v2 fp16 -> OK
zephyr-v2 int8 -> 'Today's weather is , but the forecast says 明日 rain. Also: hello ありがとう'  <-- tokens missing/merged
```

Lina: ugh token sparsity again. is this a tokenizer -> quant interaction or kvcache issue?

Ashley: initial signal points to tokenizer splits collapsing after quantized embedding table. Sparse tokens from mixed-script substrings get hashed to same buckets; int8 quantization amplifies collisions.

eval-bot: automated slice results: macaronic-2026 slice (n=1,200): BLEU delta -6.9, chrF -3.2, tokenization mismatch 12.8% vs baseline. See quick report: https://redwood.internal/runs/zephyrv2-macaronic-1735556666

Sasha: can we reproduce with deterministic seed? run with --deterministic and dump token ids.

Ashley: did that, attaching token id snippet:

```
# token ids for '今天天气很好،'
fp16 ids: [345, 9872, 1203, 44, 2051]
int8 ids: [345, 9872, 1203, 44, 2051]
# but after concatenated '...ありがとう' sequence, intermediate join produces a single OOV id 99999 in int8 run
```

Jorge: sounds like quant-induced embedding collapse. Try per-channel quantization (PCQ) vs per-tensor. Also try higher clip param.

Lina: also run with tokenizer normalization on (NFKC + remove zwj/zwnj) — macaronic samples often include invisible joiners.

Ashley: plan: (1) run bisect between quant kernels (per-tensor vs per-channel) (2) rerun tokenizer normalization + re-eval (3) check embedding table init collision stats. I'll kick off jobs.

Sasha: +1. If it's embedding collision we should consider reserving a tiny fp16 tail for rare tokens as a temporary rollback.

Ashley: starting jobs now. I'll post results in thread. cc @security for any data concerns (macaronic test uses scraped subtitles - ok to keep internal). :pray:

eval-bot: queued jobs: 1735556675, 1735556682, 1735556699

Jorge: thanks. if we get consistent regressions, open a bringup ticket and mark zephyr-v2 int8 as 'do-not-serve-multilang' until fixed.

Ashley: will do. end.
